from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_tools import Cut, MultiCut, CartesianCut

# Define individual jet multiplicity cuts
jet_multiplicity_cuts = [
    Cut(name="4jets", function=lambda x: x.JetGood.counts == 4),
    Cut(name="5jets", function=lambda x: x.JetGood.counts == 5),
    Cut(name="6jets", function=lambda x: x.JetGood.counts >= 6),
]

# Define individual b-tag multiplicity cuts
btag_multiplicity_cuts = [
    Cut(name="2btags", function=lambda x: x.BTagGood.counts == 2),
    Cut(name="3btags", function=lambda x: x.BTagGood.counts >= 3),
]

# Wrap each binning as a multi-bin cut
jet_bins = MultiCut(
    name="jet_multiplicity",
    cuts=jet_multiplicity_cuts
)

btag_bins = MultiCut(
    name="btag_multiplicity",
    cuts=btag_multiplicity_cuts
)

# Create cartesian product of the two binnings
analysis_categories = CartesianCut(
    name="analysis_categories",
    cuts=[jet_bins, btag_bins]
)

# Use in configuration
cfg = {
    "categories": analysis_categories
}

from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_tools import Cut, MultiCut, CartesianCut

# Define individual jet multiplicity cuts
jet_multiplicity_cuts = [
    Cut(name="4jets", function=lambda x: x.JetGood.counts == 4),
    Cut(name="5jets", function=lambda x: x.JetGood.counts == 5),
    Cut(name="6jets", function=lambda x: x.JetGood.counts >= 6),
]

# Define individual b-tag multiplicity cuts
btag_multiplicity_cuts = [
    Cut(name="2btags", function=lambda x: x.BTagGood.counts == 2),
    Cut(name="3btags", function=lambda x: x.BTagGood.counts >= 3),
]

# Wrap each binning as a multi-bin cut
jet_bins = MultiCut(
    name="jet_multiplicity",
    cuts=jet_multiplicity_cuts
)

btag_bins = MultiCut(
    name="btag_multiplicity",
    cuts=btag_multiplicity_cuts
)

# Create cartesian product of the two binnings
analysis_categories = CartesianCut(
    name="analysis_categories",
    cuts=[jet_bins, btag_bins]
)

# Use in configuration
cfg = {
    "categories": analysis_categories
}
